# shape: squircle (system mask or macOS 26 template) | freeform (legacy Mac silhouette) | circle
# bg: solid | gradient | white | black | illus (scene or rendered illustration) | none (freeform)
# glyph: letter | wordmark | text (CJK or words as the mark) | abstract | object | mascot
# elements: distinct shapes in the mark; depth: flat | soft (shading, gentle gradient) | 3d (rendered material)
# text: 1 when words or several letters appear; motif: what the mark depicts; pick: why it is a best pick
